selected_evidence.summary: Direct stat output shows `/srv/drop` is `root:root`, mode `1777` (`drwxrwxrwt`); final entry count is zero.

selected_evidence.requirement: Users can write but cannot remove files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Distinct unprivileged users created files; cross-owner removal attempts failed with `Operation not permitted`; owners successfully removed their own files. The behavior also passed after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after work, node1 reports CentOS 10 and kernel `6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64`; no packages or kernel changes were made.

Baseline showed boot ID `be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad`, running system state, correct permissions, and persistent canary data. The native reboot was acknowledged. node1 returned with boot ID `de13bc6d-6a1a-4566-a0bb-bba08f49472c`; system state was running, permissions and canary data recovered, and sticky-directory behavior passed again.
